name: Honor
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Honor Device Co., Ltd.). Complements the Huawei fleet, which explicitly excludes Honor.

name: OPPO
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Guangdong OPPO Mobile Telecommunications). Word-boundary pattern avoids Koppo/Toppower false hits.

name: vivo
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (vivo Mobile Communication). Full-name pattern avoids Vivotek/Vivox false hits.

name: Realme
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Realme Chongqing Mobile Telecommunications).

name: OnePlus
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (OnePlus Technology/Electronics/Tech, Shenzhen).

name: Meizu
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Meizu Technology). Small assignment count but genuine.

name: ZTE
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (ZTE Corporation). Covers phones and operator gateways/ONTs.

name: Nubia
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Nubia Technology, ZTE sub-brand).

name: Lenovo
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Lenovo entities). Motorola Mobility assignments are split into their own fleet.

name: Motorola
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Motorola Mobility LLC, a Lenovo Company). Distinct from the Motorola Vigilant law-enforcement fleet.

name: Xiaomi
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Xiaomi Communications / Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software / Beijing Xiaomi Electronics). Product-level Xiaomi devices are in the MiBeacon and Theengs fleets.

name: Aqara / Lumi
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Lumi United Technology, Aqara's parent). Only 2 MA-L blocks exist; most Aqara gear is identified via BLE, not OUI.

name: Yeelight / Yeelink
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Yeelink, Qingdao — Yeelight's operating entity). Only 1 MA-L block exists.

name: Roborock
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Beijing Roborock Technology). Most units ship with module-vendor OUIs; this is a supplement.

name: Dreame
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Dreame Technology / Innovation, Suzhou). Anchored patterns avoid Shenzhen Adreamer.

name: Midea
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (GD Midea Air-Conditioning / Midea Group). Anchored to avoid Limidea.

name: Haier
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Qingdao Haier entities).

name: Gree
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (GREE Electric Appliances, Inc. of Zhuhai). Full-name pattern avoids the many unrelated Green* companies.

name: Hisense
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Hisense entities; the Hisense Hitachi JV block is MA-M only).

name: TCL
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (TCL King / Shenzhen TCL New Technology / TCL MOKA et al.).

name: Skyworth
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Shenzhen Skyworth Digital et al. — operator set-top boxes and TVs).

name: Konka
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Konka Group / Shenzhen Konka Telecommunication).

name: Changhong
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Sichuan Changhong Electric et al.).

name: FiberHome
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Fiberhome Telecommunication Technologies). Major operator gateway/ONT OEM.

name: Mercury
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Shenzhen Mercury Communication Technologies, TP-Link's budget brand). COMMUNICATION qualifier is mandatory — bare 'Mercury' hits US defense/security firms.

name: FAST
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Shenzhen FAST Technologies, TP-Link brand). Full-name pattern mandatory — bare 'FAST' is unusable.

name: H3C
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (New H3C Technologies / Hangzhou H3C / New H3C Intelligence Terminal).

name: Qihoo 360
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Shenzhen Qihoo Intelligent / Qihoo 360 Technology / 360 AI Technology).

name: EZVIZ
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Hangzhou Ezviz Software). Hikvision sub-brand with its own IEEE entity; no OUI overlap with Hikvision.

name: Anker
notes: IEEE MA-L blocks of Fantasia Trading LLC, Anker Innovations' US trading entity — Anker itself has no IEEE entry under its own name. Covers eufy/Soundcore/Anker gear using these blocks.

name: Baseus
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Shenzhen Baseus Technology).

name: UGREEN
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Ugreen Group Limited).

name: Broadlink
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Hangzhou BroadLink Technology / Broadlink Pty Ltd).

name: Narwal / Yunjing
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Yunjing Intelligent Technology, Dongguan — Narwal's legal entity; IEEE spells it 'lntelligent'). Only 1 block exists.

name: Xiaotiancai / BBK
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (BBK Educational Electronics, Dongguan — maker of Xiaotiancai/imoo kids watches). Xiaotiancai has no IEEE entry of its own; the imoo substring alone would hit Kiwimoore Semiconductor.

name: NIO
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (NIO Co., Ltd., Shanghai). Only 1 confirmed block; a second 'Nio' entry (MA-M, San Jose) is unverifiable and excluded.

name: Espressif module
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Espressif Inc. / Espressif Systems Singapore). MODULE vendor: a hit means the device contains an ESP8266/ESP32 module, NOT that the end product is Espressif-branded. Low specificity by design.

name: Quectel module
notes: IEEE MA-L vendor block (Quectel Wireless Solutions). MODULE vendor: a hit means the device contains a Quectel cellular/Wi-Fi module, not a Quectel end product. Low specificity by design.

name: Dahua (augment)
notes: Augments the stock Dahua fleet (which had name rules only) with its IEEE MA-L blocks. Shanghai Dahua Scale Factory excluded (different company).

name: Hikvision (augment)
notes: Augments the stock Hikvision fleet (which had name rules only) with its IEEE MA-L blocks (Hangzhou Hikvision Digital / Prama Hikvision India).

name: Uniview (augment)
notes: Augments the stock Uniview fleet with its IEEE MA-L blocks (Zhejiang Uniview Technologies).

name: Tuya (augment)
notes: Augments the stock Tuya fleet with Tuya Smart Inc.'s IEEE MA-L blocks. A hit means a Tuya-platform (white-label) device.

name: DJI (augment)
notes: Augments the stock DJI fleet (name/company rules only) with its IEEE MA-L blocks (SZ DJI Technology / DJI Baiwang / Ronin / Osmo).

name: Insta360 (augment)
notes: Augments the stock Insta360 fleet with Arashi Vision Inc.'s single IEEE MA-L block (Insta360's legal entity).
